ideas.idea: The map's colour code: dark-blue buildings can be entered, light-blue ones are scenery; up close the minimap marks the door with a white line. One player (Reddit, Aileos) counted all 5,588 buildings: 1,563 can be entered, about 28%
ideas.note: The count is a fan tally, said as 'one player counted'. Not said: that some dark-blue buildings only open a small shop or corridor, mission-only interiors, the 20-building spot check.
